Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, learned counsel for 
the petitioners.
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned 
Additional C.S.C. for the State of 
Uttarakhand/respondents.
3. It is contended by the learned counsel 
for the petitioners that the present writ 
petition has been filed by the petitioners 
against the recovery on account of reduction 
of their pay-scale, which was given them in 
the year 2011.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for 
the petitioners that during the pendency of 
the present writ petition, petitioner No.4 has 
retired on 30.06.2022.
5. Now, learned counsel for the petitioners 
has pressed the interim relief application 
(IA/8/2024) for the reason that petitioner 
No.4 wants his regular pension and other 
retiral dues.
6. Learned State Counsel prays for and is 
granted 48 hours’ time to seek instructions 
to that effect, particularly, with regard to the 
petitioner No.4.
7. List on 07.05.2024 along with 
connected matters, after fresh cases.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 03.05.2024
PN
